What's new in 0.21.0

• Live TV: move up and down the channel names; Right to see what's on. OK plays the channel.
• Favourites: hold OK on a channel name to add or remove it. The Favourites category shows only your favourites, instantly.
• Reminders: OK on a show that hasn't started sets a reminder; Zylo tells you when it starts and can switch to it.
• The category menu keeps focus until you pick one or press Back.
